notes: Full portrait SITE overlay (printed sideways). Renames the site: both bars read '•CORUSCANT: SENATE LANDING PLATFORM' (red • on Light bar). Light half (right column, blue saber glow) text: 'Starships may deploy here. Once per turn, may ▼ a starship site…' (stub expands ▼). Dark half (left column, red saber glow): inline sphere before 'Wipe Them Out, All Of Them' is blue-white-violet = the Original Virtual Set 9 sphere (matched against assets/icons/ovs-set-9.png; Wipe Them Out, All Of Them (V) is a VS9 card) → {ovs:9}; the stub reads it '[Empire]' (wrong). Icon boxes on both bars (outermost first): planet, exterior (sky with sun); NO scomp ring on either bar. Bottom margin: VS13 set sphere plus a black EPISODE I disc → icons ['episode1']. BASE: the stub's 'Decipher base: [[Coruscant: Docking Bay]]' is the Special Edition DARK card (scomp, no Light Force); the slip is the Light card with Episode I and Light Force icons = the Coruscant-set Light 'Coruscant: Docking Bay (Coruscant)' (Cor-L-coruscantdockingbay.gif, icons Exterior/Planet, no scomp) — used that. Printed texts: Light 'Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force.', Dark '… requires 2 Force.' Only a 490×352 scan. Copyright year not legible here; Coruscant set line read as © 2000 on Lieutenant Williams (vs13/08) — brief's table says 2001, the scans say 2000.
